scope: Round 1 audit of the 55 fr keys this branch adds (47 in ui.agents.config, 8 in ui.agents.teams). They were judged against the English, the translator context, the existing fr ui.agents.* glossary, fr CLDR plurals and French typography. Existing catalogue values are terminology context only and were not re-audited. Note: the audited fr files are uncommitted working-tree edits on top of head f6e6260da1, identified by the sha256 values below.

nit.description: FR wraps {name} in « » (U+202F inside), which the English does not have. The identifier itself stays exactly as given, so the assistant still matches it by name. Fine to keep; noted only because it departs from the source. Disposition: no change required.

'Arrêté sur une erreur' and its sibling 'Terminé avec une erreur' use different prepositions. 'sur une erreur' is idiomatic for stopping on an error, and the two headings still read as distinct, as the context asks. Disposition: no change required.

The many arm renders count=1000000 as '1 000 000 d’outils ajoutés/retirés'. With digits, 'de' is slightly less natural than with 'million', but this follows the established fr convention (104 of 131 many arms across the fr catalogues use '# de/d’', including ui.agents.config.definitions). Disposition: no change required; convention-consistent.
